title: The Λ-CDM Tension in Recent H₀ Measurements: A Bayesian Reanalysis
abstract: We perform a Bayesian reanalysis of H₀ tension combining Planck 2018 CMB measurements with low-redshift distance ladder constraints. Our analysis reveals systematic offsets not captured by standard ΛCDM error budgets.

title: Neural Emulators for Dark Matter Halo Mass Functions at z > 2
abstract: We train neural network emulators on a suite of N-body simulations to predict halo mass functions at z > 2 with sub-percent accuracy, enabling rapid cosmological inference without repeated simulation runs.

title: Gravitational Wave Standard Sirens and the Hubble Constant: Constraints from Binary Neutron Star Mergers
abstract: We derive H₀ constraints from binary neutron star merger GW events, using electromagnetic counterparts as host galaxy identifiers. Independent of distance ladder calibrations, our result is consistent with both Planck and SH0ES values.

title: Constraints on σ₈ from CMB-Lensing × Galaxy-Survey Cross-Correlations
abstract: We cross-correlate CMB lensing maps from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope with galaxy overdensity maps from the Dark Energy Survey Year 3, obtaining a 3.1σ constraint on σ₈ that is in mild tension with Planck ΛCDM predictions.

title: Galaxy Cluster Counts from Combined SZ and X-ray Surveys: Cosmological Implications
abstract: We combine cluster catalogs from the South Pole Telescope SZ survey and eROSITA X-ray survey to constrain Ωm and σ₈. The joint analysis reduces parameter uncertainties by 35% compared to either survey alone.

title: Baryonic Feedback in Halo Models: Constraints from Weak Lensing Power Spectra
Primordial Non-Gaussianity Constraints from the CMB Bispectrum in Single-Field Inflation
Light-Cone N-body Simulations for Next-Generation Cosmological Surveys
A Bayesian Reassessment of the Distance Ladder and H₀ Tension
abstract: We construct a hierarchical Bayesian model of the distance ladder incorporating Cepheid, Tip of the Red Giant Branch, and Type Ia supernova calibrators. Our simultaneous fit yields H₀ = 71.5 ± 1.3 km/s/Mpc, partially alleviating the tension with Planck.

title: Subhalo Abundance Matching Revisited: WDM versus CDM at Sub-Galactic Scales
abstract: We revisit subhalo abundance matching predictions for warm dark matter (WDM) models against Milky Way satellite counts, finding that WDM particle masses below 3.5 keV are in tension with observed subhalo populations.

title: Intrinsic Alignment Models for Weak Gravitational Lensing: A Comparative Study
abstract: We compare five intrinsic alignment (IA) models against data from DES Y3 cosmic shear, finding that the nonlinear alignment model with tidal torquing corrections best describes galaxy shape correlations at separations below 10 Mpc/h.

title: Intrinsic Alignments in Stage-IV Surveys: Challenges and Mitigation Strategies
abstract: Conference proceedings summarising current challenges in modelling and mitigating intrinsic alignment contamination in weak lensing analyses targeting Stage-IV surveys such as LSST and Euclid.
